reason: The README clearly describes a DSH plugin whose primary purpose is durable, inspectable agent memory with recall, search, import, review, and settings management backed by a local Noema server.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 提供基于本地 Noema 服务的持久化智能体记忆、召回、搜索、导入和管理工具。
summaries.en: Provides DSH with local Noema-backed tools for persistent agent memory, recall, search, import, review, and management.

capabilities: Stores and retrieves durable agent memories as local Markdown files
Provides tools for memory recall, search, browsing, cataloging, review, editing, and deletion
Imports memory files from other AI coding tools
Reads and updates configurable local memory and settings paths
Starts and restarts a local noema-mcp child process
